user.title: Connect to Pantry Raider
user.description: Point this at your Pantry Raider install. Leave the API key blank to pair: you approve a code on the kitchen screen instead of copying a key by hand.

data.api_key: API key (optional; leave blank to pair)

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add this Pantry Raider install?
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found {name} on your network. Add it now and approve the pairing code on the kitchen screen.

pair.title: Approve on your kitchen
pair.description: Pantry Raider is showing pairing code {code}. Approve the request on the kitchen screen (or in Pantry Raider under Settings, Bandit Remotes), then press Submit here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Pantry Raider
reauth_confirm.description: Approve the code on the kitchen screen or in Pantry Raider under Settings, Bandit Remotes, or paste a key made in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Pantry Raider at that address. Check the host and port, and that you used the LAN address.
error.invalid_auth: Pantry Raider rejected the API key. Copy it from Settings, Security.
error.pairing_pending: Not approved yet. Approve it on the kitchen, then try again.
error.pairing_unavailable: Pairing is unavailable on this install (it may be turned off in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security). Paste an API key instead.
error.pairing_key_missing: The kitchen approved Home Assistant, but its key did not arrive. Press Submit to try again.

abort.already_configured: This Pantry Raider install is already set up.
abort.pairing_denied: The pairing request was denied on the kitchen.
abort.pairing_expired: The pairing request expired. Start again and approve it within a few minutes.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: How often Home Assistant checks Pantry Raider for updates, and whether Pantry Raider is given a link back to Home Assistant for cameras, Stream Deck keys and thermometers. Turning the link off removes only the tokens this integration created.

data.connect_back: Let Pantry Raider connect back to Home Assistant

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Which spoken requests Pantry Raider answers. Leave timer sentences off if something else in your home already answers "set a timer": two listeners for the same sentence collide. The services work either way, so your own automations can call them.

data.recipe_sentences: Answer recipe requests ("show me the lasagna recipe")
data.timer_sentences: Answer timer requests ("set a 10 minute pasta timer")
data.ring: Ring the voice device that set a timer when it finishes

satellite.title: A voice device
satellite.description: Pick the voice device to set up.

data.recipes: Allow recipe requests from this device
data.screen: Screen that shows what this device is asked for

data_description.timers: Pantry Raider timers show on every Pantry Raider screen and ring this device when they finish.
data_description.screen: Screens come from your Pantry Raider. A tablet appears here once its app has connected.

camera_popup.name: Camera pop-up
camera_popup.description: Pop a camera feed up on a Pantry Raider screen, for example when someone rings the doorbell.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Which Pantry Raider screen shows the pop-up. Leave empty to use your main install when only one is set up.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera's name as set on Pantry Raider's Cameras page. Leave empty for the first configured camera.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the pop-up stays on screen. Leave at 0 to use the length set in Pantry Raider.

camera_detect.name: Camera detection
camera_detect.description: Report a camera detection and let Pantry Raider decide whether to pop the camera up, using each camera's own "pop up on" checkboxes. One automation can send every detection type it sees.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Which Pantry Raider screen shows the pop-up. Leave empty to use your main install when only one is set up.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera's name as set on Pantry Raider's Cameras page. Leave empty for the first configured camera.

detection_type.name: Detection type
detection_type.description: What the camera saw. Visitor means a doorbell button press.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the pop-up stays on screen. Leave at 0 to use the length set in Pantry Raider.

probe_alert.name: Probe alert
probe_alert.description: Pantry Raider calls this when a thermometer probe reaches its target. It fires the pantry_raider_probe_alert event with the alert's details, so automations can react.

show_recipe.name: Show a recipe
show_recipe.description: Find a recipe by what was said and show it on a screen. Returns what happened and a line to say aloud.

query.name: Recipe
query.description: What was asked for, such as lasagna.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen to show this on. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

cook.name: Cook a recipe
cook.description: Open a recipe to cook, found by what was said: cook mode at step 1 on a screen, read out. When several fit, the answer lists them and asks which one; call again with the answer as the choice.

query.name: Recipe
query.description: What was asked for, such as key lime pie.

page.name: Page
page.description: cook opens cook mode at step 1 and reads it out; recipe shows the whole recipe.

choice.name: Choice
choice.description: The answer to "which one?", such as the second one or the best-ever one.

slug.name: Recipe id
slug.description: The slug of one of the recipes offered, to open it directly.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen whose recipe this is. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device, or the kitchen's current recipe when it has none.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, recipes) are applied.

get_recipe.name: Get the recipe being cooked
get_recipe.description: The recipe open on a screen: title, servings, ingredients with amounts, numbered steps, their timers, and the step the cook is on. Returns a line to say aloud too.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen whose recipe this is. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device, or the kitchen's current recipe when it has none.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, recipes) are applied.

recipe_step.name: Move to a recipe step
recipe_step.description: Move the step the cook is on (the screen follows) and read it out: first, next, back, repeat, last, or a step number.

step.name: Step
step.description: first, next, back, repeat, last, or a step number.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen whose recipe this is. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device, or the kitchen's current recipe when it has none.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, recipes) are applied.

start_recipe_timer.name: Start a recipe timer
start_recipe_timer.description: Start a timer the open recipe calls for, named after its step's action. Pick it by step number or by words; with neither, the current step's timer starts. Several that fit come back as choices to ask about.

query.name: Which timer
query.description: Words that name it, such as the crust or baking it.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen whose recipe this is. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device, or the kitchen's current recipe when it has none.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, recipes) are applied.

show.name: Show the timers
show.description: Move the screen to its timers once the timer starts. Off keeps the recipe up.

start_timer.name: Start a timer
start_timer.description: Start a timer in Pantry Raider. It shows on every Pantry Raider screen.

duration.name: Length
duration.description: Seconds, or words such as 10 minutes or an hour and a half.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the timer is for, such as pasta.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen to show this on. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel a timer
cancel_timer.description: Cancel a timer by name or id, the only one running, or all of them.

timer_id.name: Timer id
timer_id.description: The timer's id in Pantry Raider.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

dismiss_timer.name: Dismiss a finished timer
dismiss_timer.description: Stop the ringing: dismiss one finished timer, or every finished timer.

timer_id.name: Timer id
timer_id.description: Leave empty to dismiss every finished timer.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

timer_status.name: Timer status
timer_status.description: How much time is left on the timers, with a line to say aloud.

name.name: Name
name.description: One timer's name. Leave empty for all of them.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

show_page.name: Show a page
show_page.description: Move one screen to a Pantry Raider page, open the whole Pantry Raider interface on it, or close what it was showing.

page.name: Page
page.description: app (the whole interface, starting at the start page), home, recipe, cook (cook mode: the recipe one large step at a time), timers or close.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: The id of the screen to show this on. Leave empty to use the screen chosen for the voice device.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

get_routing.name: Voice device choices
get_routing.description: What one voice device is set to: where its timers go, whether recipes are allowed, and which screen it uses.

satellite.name: Voice device
satellite.description: The assist_satellite entity that heard the request. Its own choices (screen, timers, recipes) are applied.

pair_needed.title: Pair Home Assistant with Pantry Raider

confirm.title: Pair Home Assistant with Pantry Raider
confirm.description: This Pantry Raider install accepts Home Assistant without a key today, but that stops once a password is set. Pair now so it keeps working.

pairing_off.title: Pairing is turned off in Pantry Raider

confirm.title: Pairing is turned off in Pantry Raider
confirm.description: Turn on device pairing in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security (Allow devices on your home network to request access), then press Submit.

app_update_needed.title: Update Pantry Raider
app_update_needed.description: Update Pantry Raider so Home Assistant can give it a limited account instead of the owner account.

open_install_grace.title: Pantry Raider needs a password
open_install_grace.description: Pantry Raider at {host} has no password, so from {date} it stops answering requests that come through a proxy or tunnel. To keep that access, turn on two-factor sign-in in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security, then set a password there. Signing in from outside your home network needs both.

open_install_name.title: Pantry Raider does not know one of its names
open_install_name.description: Pantry Raider at {host} was opened by a name it does not know, so from {date} it stops answering that name. If you use that name, add it under Other names for this kitchen in Pantry Raider under Settings, Security.

manual_token.title: Pantry Raider uses a token you pasted
manual_token.description: Pantry Raider is using a Home Assistant token that was pasted into its settings, so this integration leaves it as it is. To let the integration give Pantry Raider a limited account of its own, clear that token in Pantry Raider under Settings, Home Assistant, then reload this integration.

device_needed.message: Pick which Pantry Raider device this should show on.

device_unknown.message: That device is not known to Home Assistant.

device_not_pantry_raider.message: That device is not a Pantry Raider device.

device_not_loaded.message: That Pantry Raider device is not loaded right now.

request_refused.message: Pantry Raider did not accept this: {detail}

key_rejected.message: Pantry Raider rejected the API key for this call.

message_empty.message: Add a message or a title to show on the screen.

screen_refused.message: Pantry Raider could not change the screen: {detail}

unreachable.message: Could not reach this Pantry Raider device (it may be offline or an older version).
